# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record the information relevant to the failed brake tests in the blank inspection report.
3. Use the information from the records, as well as what you have learnt in class, to write out the inspection report description for the failed brake test(s).

Note: You may record more than one brake test failure per report.

# Instructions for printing the blank inspection report PDF

1. Print the PDF file 2-sided, with the short side of the paper being the side of the document that gets flipped over. NB: The PDF file has been formatted so that this is the desired effect.
2. Wait a few moments for all the pages to load before printing it. The page numbers will appear on each side of the page.

Remember to re-name your PDF file before uploading it to the appropriate assignment dropbox.

**Instructions for documenting inspection reports on a mobile device:**

1. Navigate to http://www.docdroid.
